title: Phylogenetic Analysis of mtCO1 Sequences
author: Joachim Nwezeobi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd44i8yw

steps.title: Screen and Quality Check Sequences
steps.instruction: Perform quality checks on partial mtCO1 sequences obtained from two randomly selected whiteflies per location using Geneious (v10.2.6).

substeps.instruction: Translate sequences using the invertebrate mitochondrial genetic code.
Discard poor quality sequences or those containing stop codons and repeat the sequencing process for those samples.

steps.title: Assemble and Align Sequences
steps.instruction: Assemble and align the sequences that passed quality control.

substeps.instruction: Align sequences with 691 B. tabaci mtCO1 reference sequences downloaded from GenBank.

steps.title: Identify Genetic Groups
steps.instruction: Plot an initial phylogenetic tree using the FastTree program in Geneious (v10.2.6) to identify whitefly genetic groups.

steps.title: Extract Haplotypes and Prepare Final Alignment
steps.instruction: Extract unique haplotypes and prepare the final alignment for the main phylogenetic tree.

substeps.instruction: Identify and extract 29 unique haplotypes from the 238 sequences using Geneious 10.2.6.
Combine these unique sequences with 18 selected reference sequences and align them.
Include a mtCO1 sequence of Aleurodicus dispersus Russell (GenBank code: AJ748380) as an outgroup.

steps.title: Evaluate Nucleotide Evolution Model
steps.instruction: Evaluate the best model of nucleotide sequence evolution using jModelTest (v2.1.10).

steps.title: Run Bayesian Phylogenetic Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform phylogenetic analysis using MrBayes (v3.2.6) with nexus-formatted aligned sequences.

substeps.instruction: Apply the Generalised time-reversible (GTR) model and Gamma distribution with invariant sites (G+I).
Run four chains for 50 million generations.

steps.title: Visualize and Annotate Tree
steps.instruction: View and annotate the resulting phylogenetic tree.

substeps.instruction: Use the consensus tree (.nex.con.tre) file to view the tree and posterior probabilities of the branches using FigTree (v1.4.3).
Annotate the tree using Adobe Illustrator (v22.1).

steps.title: Submit Sequences to GenBank
steps.instruction: Submit the 29 unique haplotype sequences to the GenBank sequence database to obtain unique accession numbers.
